item.tib: bon skyong spyi yi bskang gsol ud pal rgyas pa'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar bon skyong spyi yi bsang mchod kyis/ tshig bshad ud pal rgyas pa'i 'phreng ba'i phreng ba zhes/ mkhan nyi ri shel bzhin 'bod pa des/ sgo gsum g.yeng bral bcad rgya gnas mtshams su/ 'di lta'i 'khrul snang byung bar brten/ lha srung thugs dam mnyes phyir 'phral brtsams bgyis/ sdeb nyes lung 'gal nor 'khrul 'chis (mchis)pa nas/ skyabs gnas lha srung tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge bas bdag sogs mtha' yas sems can rnams/ don gnyis lhun grub sku gsum 'bras thob shog/
